jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the ads that introduce Kit & Kin to thousands of new customers?
Co-founded by Spice Girl Emma Bunton, Kit & Kin is a certified B Corp creating everyday essentials for families, with award-winning baby and cleaning products sold through DTC, Amazon and retail channels.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own our paid social creative strategy, track and analyse ad performance, and turn those insights into stronger advertising.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines creative thinking with analytical confidence and wants real ownership, autonomy and impact within a growing ecommerce brand.

THE ROLE:

You’ll take ownership of the creative development and performance analysis behind our paid social advertising, with Meta as your primary focus.

You’ll be accountable for understanding which ads, hooks, messages and formats are working, which are underperforming and what we should do next. You’ll use those findings to develop successful formats further, improve weaker concepts and identify fresh creative opportunities.

Working closely with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, internal creative team and external creators, you’ll take ideas from customer insight through scripting, briefing, production and testing. You’ll help us make more of our founder, expert, creator and product content across nappies, wipes, skincare and cleaning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys writing a compelling script as much as analysing the results. You’ll own creative reporting and recommendations, partnering with performance marketing to translate better creative into more efficient customer acquisition.

RESPONSABILITIES:

Creative performance tracking and analysis

Own our ad creative performance tracker and weekly reporting, clearly identifying what is working, what isn’t and the recommended next steps.
Establish consistent naming and tagging to compare performance by concept, format, hook, message, creator and product.
Analyse CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, click-through rate and video engagement alongside spend to understand commercial outcomes and where ads lose attention.
Investigate results with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, accounting for differences in audience, placement, offer, landing page and the amount of data available.
Identify emerging winners and signs of creative fatigue, and turn findings into prioritised recommendations and production briefs.

Creative strategy and testing

Own a creative testing roadmap aligned with commercial priorities, product launches, and production capacity.
Define clear hypotheses and agree success measures for each test with performance marketing.
Develop successful formats further through new hooks, scripts, creators, lengths and product angles.
Diagnose underperforming creative and recommend specific improvements, further testing or retirement.
Document results and learnings so each round of creative builds on the last.

Concepts, copy and production

Research customer reviews, surveys, social comments and customer service feedback to uncover motivations, objections and opportunities.
Develop concepts for video, static and carousel ads, including demonstrations, testimonials, founder stories, expert advice and offers.
Work with a copywriter to create compelling hooks, scripts, headlines and calls to action that communicate product benefits clearly in our brand voice.
Brief creators, copywriters, editors and designers with clear direction on the audience, message, opening, footage and intended test.
Plan scripts and shot lists for founder, expert and product shoots, and repurpose existing footage into fresh ads.
Give actionable feedback on storytelling, pacing, visuals and messaging, keeping production moving to agreed deadlines.
Ensure creative follows our product claims and brand guidelines, with appropriate usage permissions confirmed.
Stay informed about competitor advertising, platform developments and emerging formats to identify relevant opportunities.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

3+ years’ relevant experience in performance creative strategy, paid social or a related role within an ecommerce brand or agency.
Proven experience developing paid social creative for DTC or ecommerce brands, particularly on Meta.
Hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager to track, analyse and compare performance at ad level.
A portfolio demonstrating how you have used results to improve creative, with clear examples of your contribution and the impact.
Strong analytical and reporting skills, including confidence with Excel or Google Sheets.
A sound understanding of CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion and video engagement metrics, including their limitations.
Experience designing creative tests and translating findings into new concepts and iterations.
Excellent copywriting and storytelling skills, with the ability to write engaging hooks and natural, persuasive scripts.
Experience briefing creators, video editors and designers and providing constructive creative feedback.
Strong commercial understanding of customer acquisition and the role of creative in ecommerce growth.
Excellent organisation, communication and collaboration skills, with the confidence to take ownership and challenge assumptions.

NICE TO HAVES:

Experience with subscription ecommerce businesses or family, skincare and household products.
Experience with TikTok creative, creator partnership ads or directing shoots.
Understanding of landing page messaging and conversion rate optimisation.
Practical video editing or design skills.
Experience using AI tools to support research, ideation, analysis or production workflows.

WHAT YOU'LL GET:

Competitive salary depending on experience
25 days holiday plus bank holidays.
Fully remote work with monthly meetings in London.
40% staff discount across Kit & Kin products.
Regular team socials.
Statutory pension scheme.
Significant autonomy and ownership.
Opportunity to play a key role in scaling a purpose-driven brand.

JOIN US ON OUR JOURNEY

We’re looking for someone curious, commercially minded and passionate about improving advertising through strong ideas and clear evidence.

If you’re excited by the opportunity to shape Kit & Kin’s creative and see the impact of your work, we’d love to hear from you.

Please include your CV and two or three examples of paid social creative you’ve worked on, explaining your contribution, the results and how you used those findings to develop the creative further. Anonymised results are welcome where information is confidential.

—comprising Klick Health (including Oxford PharmaGenesis, Klick Katalyst, and btwelve), Klick Media, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), and Klick Consulting—is an ecosystem dedicated help life sciences brands achieve their full potential through best-in-class marketing and advertising, media, medical affairs and communications, market access, real-world evidence, and technology and analytics consulting — powered by 500+ in-house medical experts and award-winning data science and AI capabilities. Founded in 1997, we have offices in Toronto, New York, Oxford, London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Melbourne, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, São Paulo, and Singapore. Our Creative Craft brings Klick’s ideas to life through storytelling, design, and experience. This craft blends imagination with strategy to create work that is emotionally resonant and culturally relevant. Creative teams collaborate across disciplines to simplify complexity and humanise healthcare. Their work drives engagement, understanding, and meaningful action across channels.

The Associate Creative Director (Art) provides senior art direction across healthcare and pharmaceutical brands, shaping conceptual ideas, visual systems, and integrated campaign work from brief through final execution. The role partners closely with Copy, Strategy, Client Services, Medical, and Regulatory teams to ensure creative work is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, medically accurate, and appropriate for regulated environments. Experience presenting creative work to senior internal stakeholders and clients, including explaining concept rationale, visual decisions, audience relevance, and responses to feedback.
Experience reviewing and directing visual work across multiple concurrent projects, including working within agency creative workflows and medical/regulatory approval processes while maintaining quality and deadlines.
Experience mentoring or guiding art directors, designers, or other creatives through concept development, design reviews, and feedback, with evidence of helping improve creative quality or team capability.

Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
Experience developing work across HCP, patient, payer, or disease awareness audiences, including adapting visual systems while maintaining strategic and medical accuracy.
Experience contributing senior creative thinking to pitches, new business presentations, or client growth opportunities within healthcare, pharma, or life sciences.
Advanced working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Keynote, and presentation design tools, with examples of using them across client-facing creative development.

Shape and manage the idea pipeline, balancing reactive content with bigger, format-led executions.

Position at Logitech:

Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

A leader in sustainability, Logitech designs software-enabled hardware solutions in pursuit of our mission to extend human potential in work and play.

Our Creative & Design team delivers award-winning design and creative excellence.

The Associate Creative Director is a strategically minded, hands-on creative who works closely with the Creative Director to raise the ambition, originality and effectiveness of Logitech’s creative output.

You will help shape how the brand shows up across campaigns, content and experiences, bringing together strong ideas, distinctive art direction and exceptional craft. You will be equally comfortable developing a big idea, shaping a visual world, challenging and refining creative, and getting into the detail to make the work better.

Working across Logitech Personal Workspace (PWS) and with teams across the business, you will help create attention grabbing work and creative experiences that are culturally relevant, strategically grounded and distinctly Logitech.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech.

In this role you will:

Shape creative ideas: Develop original, strategically grounded ideas that bring Logitech’s brand, products and business ambitions to life. Push beyond the expected to create work that is distinctive, relevant and memorable.
Raise the creative bar: Work closely with the Creative Director to elevate the quality, ambition and originality of our creative output. Bring a critical eye to ideas and execution, knowing when to challenge, refine or push further.
Be hands-on: Concept, art direct and design integrated creative across campaigns, content, social, digital, photography, film and other brand experiences. Remain close to the work from initial idea through to final execution.
Build compelling creative worlds: Develop strong visual and conceptual systems that give campaigns a distinctive point of view and create consistency across multiple channels and markets.
Champion the brand: Help evolve and strengthen Logitech’s creative expression, ensuring work feels unmistakably Logitech while remaining fresh, contemporary and culturally relevant.
Collaboration is key: Partner with writers, designers, strategists, marketers, producers and external creative partners to turn ambitious ideas into exceptional work. Help create an environment where the best idea wins.
Present and influence: Clearly articulate creative thinking, concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders and cross-functional partners are what helps Logitech succeed. So build confidence in the work and use feedback to make it stronger.
Put the consumer first: Develop a strong understanding of consumer mindsets, behaviours and cultural context to create work that is meaningful, useful and engaging.
Bring craft and detail: Have a deep appreciation for design, typography, photography, film, motion, digital and emerging forms of creative expression. Know that great ideas only become great work through great execution.
Stay ahead of what’s next: Keep close to culture, creativity, technology, AI and emerging creative tools. Experiment with new ways of working and look for opportunities to make our work more innovative and effective.
Champion creative ambition: Bring energy, curiosity and a restless desire to make work that stands out, earns attention and moves the brand forward.

Key Qualifications:

For this position we are looking for you to demonstrate:

10+ years of experience with a standout portfolio of original, strategically grounded, big idea driven advertising, brand and engagement work. B2C experience is essential, with B2B experience a huge plus.
A strong track record of developing and delivering high-quality integrated creative across campaigns, film/video, social, digital, photography, experiential and non-traditional media.
Exceptional conceptual and art direction skills, with the ability to turn strategic challenges into simple, compelling and distinctive creative ideas.
A high level of craft and a strong understanding of how to take an idea from initial thought through to polished final execution.
Experience working with and influencing senior creative, marketing and cross-functional stakeholders, with the ability to clearly articulate creative strategy, narrative and ideas.
Strong presentation skills and the confidence to champion creative thinking while remaining open to feedback and collaboration.
Experience working across complex, multi-channel and global brand environments, with an understanding of how to create work that can scale without losing its creative impact.
Deep production and post-production knowledge across video, CG, photography, print and digital, with the ability to collaborate effectively with production partners and specialists.
A genuine passion for advertising, design, popular culture, technology and emerging creative trends.
A strong interest in AI and emerging creative technologies, and an appetite for exploring how they can unlock better ideas, faster workflows and new forms of creative expression.
A collaborative, curious and generous creative partner who can build strong relationships across disciplines and bring people with them.
A restless drive to create truly outstanding, culturally resonant work.
A steady demeanour, strong emotional intelligence and the ability to give and receive feedback in a way that makes the work stronger — without ego.

Work with the wider team to improve creative processes, efficiency and client outcomes.

Ability to turn performance data, audience insights and campaign learnings into creative recommendations.

DEPT® is the Growth Invention Company, sitting at the intersection of marketing and technology. The Senior Creative Strategist role is part of our Creative & Media team based in Amsterdam. Our building is filled with a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Creatives, Influencer Marketers, and a range of Strategists, to Account Managers, AI Experts, and Marketing Automation Consultants. Together, we blend imaginative storytelling, forward-facing creativity, and cutting-edge technology to create impactful creative work that drives growth for our clients like Netflix, Canva, Stokke, Foot Locker, Philips & Praxis.

Job Purpose

The Creative Strategist at DEPT® are at the heart of the action, operating at the intersection of creativity, culture, humanity, business, and technology - helping create work that moves people and drives growth. We don’t have a proprietary framework or process. We don’t like to follow best practices because they’re based on the past. In a world of constant flux and endless opportunity, we believe strategy is crucial to imagine the path forward.

At this level, you are putting your foundational skills into practice and earning authority with clients and creative teams. While our seniors and directors define the vision, you are the indispensable thinker bringing it to life - owning projects, learning through doing, and finding the insights that spark great work.

Key Responsibilities

Own the project:
Step up to own more projects and see them through from start to finish, utilizing the guidance and air cover of a Senior/Director when you need it.

Interrogate the challenge:
Be a fearless, honest, and suspicious interrogator of the brand, the challenge, and the world it lives in.

Craft the springboard:
Consistently develop strategies, briefs, and thought-starters that excite, inspire and give clear direction.

Think beyond boundaries:
Connect differently shaped projects and strategies in ways that they all lead to effective outcomes.

That’s the core of it. Beyond that, we expect you to care about the work, the craft and humans, be comfortable in front of crowds and workshops, and be utterly yourself at all times.

What We Are Looking For

That’s one list. Sorry, here’s another. It’s about some traits we like:

Relentless curiosity: You love playing the investigative journalist. You get under the skin of the problem, the audience, immerse yourself in the business and throw yourself into culture - all for the betterment of the work (and because there’s no better place than a reddit rabbithole).
Intelligent imagination: You don't just observe; you make leaps of thinking that reveal entirely new ways of looking at a problem or an opportunity.
Effective storytelling: You are skilled in the art of writing, crafting arguments and telling stories in ways that help create clarity, excitement and buy-in for ideas.
Creative development: A strategy isn’t great until it leads to great work. You thrive in inspiring, supporting, protecting, and nurturing creativity from start to finish.
Distilling complexity: The world is increasingly complex and fragmented. You’re able to process, distill, and demystify that chaos into simple and compelling insights.
Finger on the pulse: You know what’s going on in culture, in tech, on social and some other weird corners of the internet, and are able to turn that knowledge into action (or just great water cooler conversation).
Team Player: There’s a perception that the best strategists are mysterious wizards who pontificate from ivory towers - not at DEPT®. Here getting to the best possible work is a team sport. Everyone does their part for the greater good.

Language requirements: We’re looking for someone who can work in Dutch and English. Any other languages are a bonus.

That’s it. Enough lists. If any of this seems right up your alley, we’d love to hear from you.

What Now

Apart from the CV we would like to see:

A short cover letter that tells us a little about you, your background, and what you want to achieve.
It doesn’t need to be super formal. Relax. No one scary will read it. Please write it in your voice.

If you have a portfolio/website, please include it
. It’s helpful to know what your role in the work was. And if you’re not currently a strategist, feel free to include some relevant samples of interesting work from other fields.

WE OFFER

A flexible, hybrid working policy (2-3 days from the office, depending on location) and the opportunity to work from abroad for 13 weeks a year.
24 vacation days per year and the possibility to buy an unlimited number of extra vacation days.
DEPT®/YOU Learning Menu and DEPT®/YOU Special Programs. Develop your skills with courses and programs tailored to your needs.
Stay happy and healthy with a contribution to your health through the OpenUp platform, gym and wellness discounts, and healthy lunches at the office.
Get a discount on your lease bike and ride in style. You can also enjoy hassle free-commutes with an NS Business Card.
A reputation for doing good. DEPT® has been a Certified B Corp® since 2021, has been named a Great Place To Work since 2022 in the Netherlands and named ‘Agency of the Year’ at both The Lovies and The Webby Awards.
Awesome clients. Whether big, small, local or global — at DEPT® you’ll get the opportunity to work with all of them. And we celebrate all of our successes together!
You can discover even more employee benefits here.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

About Stratio

Stratio keeps public transport running. We monitor fleet health in real time and tell the world's largest operators exactly what's going to fail before it does.

The role

Our go-to-market runs on industry events. You own them end to end, and the content, the website and the automation around them.

This is a hands-on, one-person marketing function. No team to manage. You’ll brief a stand builder, a film crew, a designer or a PR freelancer when the work calls for them, and do everything else yourself. You do the work. You own the output. You use every tool available - especially LLMs and automation - to do the work of an entire department.

You’ll report directly to leadership and work closely with sales and product.

If you've ever been the only marketing person at a company and thrived, this is for you.

What your weeks look like

Events and speaking

Events are a major focus of this role. You run the event calendar: the shows where we exhibit, the conferences where we speak, and our own customer roundtables, on-site events at client sites and client advisory board.

For each stand: the booking, the design, the build contract, logistics, staffing, the run of show and the debrief.

For each talk: the abstract, the co-speaker, the deadline, the deck, the rehearsal.

After every event you report meetings held against meetings booked, deals generated and deals impacted, and you follow up with the leads generated in cooperation with our sales team to ensure event leads become opportunities in our pipeline.

Content creation

You write and publish case studies, blog posts, landing pages, LinkedIn posts, one-pagers, and sales enablement materials.

You produce our benchmark report with engineering, the abstracts and decks for our speakers, and the trade-press pushes around them.

You take raw inputs - a customer success metric, a product update, a conversation with a customer - and turn them into compelling stories.

You use LLMs daily to draft, iterate, and repurpose content across formats and channels.

You move fast without sacrificing quality.

Website ownership

You manage and update the website. New pages, copy changes, landing pages for campaigns, event pages and meeting-booking pages. You’re comfortable in a CMS. You don’t file a ticket to change a headline, you just do it.

You optimize for both traditional SEO and LLM discoverability, making sure that when someone asks “what’s the best predictive maintenance product,” Stratio shows up in the answer.

Campaigns and demand generation

You plan and execute campaigns to build our pipeline. They’re designed around the event calendar: the outreach that fills the meeting schedule before each show and the follow-up after it, webinars between events, LinkedIn content, paid only to named accounts, co-marketing with partners.

You draw up the account list for each event with sales, run the outreach and fill the calendar.

You set up tracking, measure what works, and kill what doesn’t. You think in terms of pipeline contribution.

Sales enablement

You build the materials that help the sales team close. Pitch decks, case studies, proposal templates.

You sit close to sales conversations and notice when the same objection keeps coming up, then you build something to handle it.

Analytics and reporting

You set up and maintain marketing analytics.

Per event: meetings held against booked, deals generated, deals impacted, what the field taught us and what we change because of it.

Website traffic, content performance, email metrics.

In the end how much pipeline we’ve generated, from which channels. You also can explain in simple terms what’s working, what’s not, and why. You don’t need a BI team to pull numbers.

Automation and tooling

You build workflows that save time. Email sequences, content distribution, lead scoring, social scheduling, speaker deadlines, meeting booking, post-event follow-up.

You use LLMs, no-code tools / light scripting to automate repetitive work.

You’re always looking for the next thing that should be a workflow instead of manual effort.

BrandBastion transforms the way brands handle social engagement, working with some of the most recognized names in the world - Netflix, Uber, Sephora, Benefit Cosmetics, JD Sports and more. We help our partners get the most out of their social media engagement, across paid, organic, and non owned conversations. Our proprietary technology automates the management of millions of social interactions every day, while maintaining the personal quality of one-on-one conversations grounded in context, brand knowledge and TOV.

The Role:

BrandBastion is looking for a strategic, commercially minded Account Director with deep experience in organic social media, community engagement and enterprise client leadership.

This is not a paid media or campaign execution role. We need someone who understands what happens after content goes live, how brands manage communities, engage audiences, protect their reputation, deliver customer care and use social conversations to inform broader business decisions. And on top of that, understand that tooling and AI will make it possible.

You will own a portfolio of strategic accounts and be accountable for the overall customer relationship, account strategy, value realization, retention and growth. You must be comfortable acting as the primary senior partner to leaders such as Global Heads of Social, VPs of Marketing and Customer Experience executives.

Our product, technical and operational teams will support platform configuration, onboarding and workflow optimization. However, you will need to understand the platform, confidently advise customers on how to use it and take hands-on ownership of moving accounts forward.

What you'll own:

Take direct ownership of a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts, including customer outcomes, senior relationships, retention, renewals and expansion
Build trusted relationships with senior leaders across social media, marketing, brand, community and customer care
Develop a clear account strategy based on each customer's priorities, organizational structure and measures of success
Lead strategic conversations across organic social, community management, moderation, engagement, social customer care, sentiment and brand health
Connect BrandBastion's platform and services to measurable customer outcomes and business value
Lead executive business reviews that provide insights, recommendations and clear next steps
Identify adoption gaps and account risks early, then personally drive the plan to address them
Own commercial conversations related to renewals, expansion and additional BrandBastion solutions
Partner with product and technical specialists to improve workflows, platform adoption and customer results
Bring customers relevant social trends, industry knowledge, examples and strategic ideas
Maintain strong organization and follow-through across multiple complex accounts and stakeholder groups

Requirements

Experience as an Account Manager, Account Director, Client Partner, Social Strategist, Social Media Lead or senior customer leader
Experience working with large consumer brands through an agency, social technology company or in-house team
The credibility to lead a useful strategic conversation with a Global Head of Social or VP of Marketing
Strong knowledge of social strategy, community, engagement, moderation, customer care and campaign performance
A commercial mindset and experience with retention, renewals, growth or account expansion
Strong ownership, organization and follow-through
The ability to translate data and customer goals into clear recommendations
Comfort learning technology and partnering with technical specialists
A proactive, hands-on approach to managing and growing accounts

Benefits

At BrandBastion, high performers shape their own path. You'll have opportunities to:

Lead strategic initiatives that impact our Social AI-first approach
Advance into senior leadership roles based on performance
Work with global brands at the forefront of digital engagement
Be part of a fast-growing AI-first company leading the future of Social Engagement
Competitive Market Rate Compensation + 4+ weeks paid time off
Opportunities for global team meets
Flexible, Fully Remote Role: Enjoy the benefits of remote work while collaborating with a talented global team

jobs.description:
About BON CHARGE

BON CHARGE is a fast growing global wellness brand, offering the widest range of premium, science-backed products under one roof. Founded in 2017, BON CHARGE is a pioneering technology company dedicated to simplifying wellness by delivering innovative solutions that enhance sleep, recovery, beauty, and overall wellbeing.

Named by LuxLife as Best Holistic Wellness Brand 2025 in Australia, BON CHARGE is committed to delivering premium experiences. Its mission is to simplify wellness, by offering the world’s best science-backed technology together on one platform. Our values are fulfilled by supporting more than 250,000+ athletes, doctors and other customers worldwide, who have chosen to drive tangible, positive changes in their lives.

With a bold vision for continued global growth, BON CHARGE is building a world-class team and this role is an integral part of our content and creative engine.

Role Overview

We’re seeking an organised and detail focused UGC Coordinator to support the sourcing and delivery of user generated content for BON CHARGE. You will find, vet, brief and manage UGC creators and review every piece of content they deliver for use across paid advertising, product pages and selected organic social channels.

This is an output driven role with a strong focus on content quality, brand and compliance alignment, and delivery volume. The role does not cover affiliate or paid influencer partnerships.

Key Responsibilities

Creator Sourcing & Vetting

Source UGC creators directly and via creator platforms (e.g. Insense or similar) across the wellness, biohacking, beauty, fitness and lifestyle niches
Vet creators for on-camera quality, audience fit, brand alignment and reliability before onboarding
Build and maintain a creator roster segmented by customer persona, product category and market (AU, US, UK, EU, CA)

Briefing & Creator Management

Write clear creator briefs covering product, persona, funnel stage, hooks, format, length and usage rights
Negotiate creator rates, deliverables and content licensing for paid, web and organic use
Manage product seeding, creator communication, deadlines and revisions end to end

Content Review & Quality Control

Review all delivered content against the brief, brand guidelines and product claim requirements before release
Coordinate claim and compliance checks with the Scientific Affairs and Compliance team
Manage revisions and reshoots, and ensure final files are named, tagged and stored in the UGC library

Delivery for Paid, Web & Organic

Deliver a monthly pipeline of UGC assets for paid media, including multiple hook variations per video, to the acquisition and performance marketing teams
Supply UGC assets for landing pages and product detail pages in partnership with the CRO and web teams
Provide selected UGC for organic social in partnership with the Social and Community team
Support with Community Management and comment replies across paid ads & organic social content.

Reporting & Collaboration

Track creator pipeline, output volume, cost per asset and turnaround times, and report weekly to the brand and marketing leads
Feed performance learnings from paid media back into creator selection and briefs
Stay current on UGC formats, platform trends and competitor creative

Requirements

1 to 3 years of experience in UGC, creator management, content production or social media (e-commerce, wellness or beauty industry preferred)
Experience sourcing and managing creators and reviewing content for paid advertising
Working knowledge of creator platforms (e.g. Insense, Billo or similar) and content usage rights
Strong eye for what performs on Meta, TikTok and YouTube, including hooks, formats and funnel stages
Highly organised and able to manage many creators, briefs and deadlines at once
Clear written communication, particularly for briefs and creator feedback
Familiarity with regulated product claims (wellness, health or beauty) is an advantage
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote-first environment

Why Join BON CHARGE?

Be part of a global wellness brand at a pivotal growth stage
Work alongside passionate founders and a supportive executive team that truly champions innovation and creativity
Join a team that genuinely values culture, fun and connection, where wellness is something we live and breathe every day

new_jobs.description:
The Klick Group
—comprising Klick Health (including Oxford PharmaGenesis, Klick Katalyst, and btwelve), Klick Media, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), and Klick Consulting—is an ecosystem dedicated help life sciences brands achieve their full potential through best-in-class marketing and advertising, media, medical affairs and communications, market access, real-world evidence, and technology and analytics consulting — powered by 500+ in-house medical experts and award-winning data science and AI capabilities. Founded in 1997, we have offices in Toronto, New York, Oxford, London, Cambridge, Cardiff, Melbourne, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, São Paulo, and Singapore. One of the most-awarded health agencies on the planet, Klick is consistently recognised for its people-first culture as a Great Place to Work, Best Workplace for Women, Best Workplace for Inclusion, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and FORTUNE Best Workplace in Advertising. Klick also recently made history as Cannes Lions Healthcare Agency of the Year, Healthcare Network of the Year, and Independent Agency of the Year – Health.

About Our Creative Craft

Our Creative Craft brings Klick’s ideas to life through storytelling, design, and experience. This craft blends imagination with strategy to create work that is emotionally resonant and culturally relevant. Creative teams collaborate across disciplines to simplify complexity and humanise healthcare. Their work drives engagement, understanding, and meaningful action across channels.

Job Description

The Associate Creative Director (Art) provides senior art direction across healthcare and pharmaceutical brands, shaping conceptual ideas, visual systems, and integrated campaign work from brief through final execution. The role partners closely with Copy, Strategy, Client Services, Medical, and Regulatory teams to ensure creative work is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, medically accurate, and appropriate for regulated environments. The Associate Creative Director (Art) also helps raise the standard of visual craft across teams by guiding creatives, reviewing work, and presenting creative thinking to senior internal and client stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Lead concept development and art direction for integrated healthcare and pharmaceutical campaigns across digital, social, CRM, print, presentation, experiential, and other client-facing channels from initial brief through final delivery.
Direct visual quality across multiple projects and workstreams, shaping campaign systems, typography, layout, imagery, storyboards, digital experiences, and channel adaptations while maintaining consistency with strategy and brand objectives.
Partner with Copy, Strategy, Medical, Regulatory, and Client Services to develop ideas that balance creative ambition, audience relevance, scientific accuracy, usability, and regulatory requirements.
Present creative concepts, visual rationale, and campaign thinking to senior internal stakeholders and clients, responding to feedback while protecting the strategic and creative integrity of the work.
Mentor and guide art directors and designers through concept development, reviews, and feedback while contributing senior creative thinking to pitches, new business opportunities, and broader account growth initiatives.

Qualifications

Required:

7+ years of art direction or design experience in advertising, marketing, healthcare communications, or a related agency environment, with portfolio examples showing progression from concept development through final execution.
Demonstrated experience leading conceptual creative work for healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, or other regulated and complex clients, with examples of integrated campaigns across multiple channels.
Portfolio showing strong art direction across campaign concepts, visual systems, typography, layout, digital, social, CRM, presentations, and other multi-channel deliverables, with evidence of shaping overarching visual platforms.
Experience presenting creative work to senior internal stakeholders and clients, including explaining concept rationale, visual decisions, audience relevance, and responses to feedback.
Experience reviewing and directing visual work across multiple concurrent projects, including working within agency creative workflows and medical/regulatory approval processes while maintaining quality and deadlines.
Experience mentoring or guiding art directors, designers, or other creatives through concept development, design reviews, and feedback, with evidence of helping improve creative quality or team capability.

Desired:

Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
Experience developing work across HCP, patient, payer, or disease awareness audiences, including adapting visual systems while maintaining strategic and medical accuracy.
Experience contributing senior creative thinking to pitches, new business presentations, or client growth opportunities within healthcare, pharma, or life sciences.
Advanced working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, Keynote, and presentation design tools, with examples of using them across client-facing creative development.
Working knowledge of healthcare brand challenges, audience needs, therapeutic area considerations, and market dynamics, with examples of applying that understanding to visual creative work.
Bachelor’s degree in Advertising, Design, Art Direction, Visual Communications, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
